definitions.gloss: since ancient times, from olden days
definitions.explanation: From the distant past up to the present; traditionally.

examples.japanese: {古来|こらい}より{伝|つた}わる{伝統|でんとう}だ。
examples.english: It is a tradition that has been passed down since ancient times.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}では{古来|こらい}、{米|こめ}が{主食|しゅしょく}だった。
examples.english: In Japan, rice has been the staple food since ancient times.

examples.japanese: {古来|こらい}の{知恵|ちえ}を{現代|げんだい}に{生|い}かす。
examples.english: To apply ancient wisdom to modern times.

notes:
{古来|こらい} means "since ancient times" and can function as both a noun and an adverb. It is composed of {古|こ} (old) + {来|らい} (coming from).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {古来|こらい}より: since ancient times (literary)
- {古来|こらい}から: since ancient times (slightly more colloquial)
- {古来|こらい}の{知恵|ちえ}: wisdom from ancient times
- {古来|こらい}の{伝統|でんとう}: traditions from ancient times

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {昔|むかし}から: from long ago (everyday, conversational)
- {太古|たいこ}の{昔|むかし}: since very ancient times (emphasizes remoteness)
- {伝統的|でんとうてき}に: traditionally (focuses on custom, not time)
- {従来|じゅうらい}: conventionally, up to now (not as far back as {古来|こらい})

REGISTER:
{古来|こらい} has a formal, literary tone. In casual speech, {昔|むかし}から is more natural. {古来|こらい} is commonly found in written Japanese, especially when discussing history, culture, or traditions.
